title: kbsettings.layered raises must be an object for the list and string keys group, gate_checks and extension_paths, which its goal and the docs name
goal: kbsettings.layered(root, name) returns the merged value with its layer map for group (a string), gate_checks and extension_paths (lists of the layers in order), as kbext.SURFACE and kb/_self/extending.md describe them, instead of raising SettingsError 'must be an object'; kg_sync and kbext then read them through layered, not layer_files

run: import json,sys,tempfile,pathlib; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import kbsettings; d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); (d/'settings.json').write_text(json.dumps({'gate_checks':[['true']]})); kbsettings.layered(d,'gate_checks')
